idea-plugin.name: pytest Fixtures - Valid Test Data
idea-plugin.description:
pytest Fixtures — valid test data

Generate a pytest parametrized test whose cases are spec-valid values — and their invalid variants — straight from the Kassi engine. Unlike a hand-rolled faker, every value passes the real checksum, so your test exercises the validator with data that is actually valid (and edge cases that are actually invalid). Fully offline.

  • IBAN — ISO 7064 mod-97 valid, several countries, each with a bad-checksum variant.
  • Card (PAN) — Luhn-valid per network, each with a fails-Luhn variant.

Open it from View ▸ Tool Windows ▸ pytest Fixtures, pick a kind, Generate, then Copy the @pytest.mark.parametrize test into your package. Platform-only — installs in PyCharm and every IntelliJ-based IDE.

More from the Kassi QA & fintech toolkit:

Spec-valid test data: Kassi Test Data · Go Test Data · UUID / ULID / NanoID Toolkit · HTTP Data Injector

Fintech & validators: Checksum & Regex Playground · ACH / NACHA Toolkit · ISO 8583 Inspector · SWIFT MT Validator

QA & testing: Flaky Test Linter · Compose Testability Linter · MRZ & Barcode Inspector · Secret & Card Leak Guard · dbt Navigator

Source, issues & docs: github.com/VadimToptunov/kassi-plugins
